rules.title: P.L. 2025, c.405 (Residential rental property application fee limit)
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property that exceeds $50. The cap is adjusted each January 1 by the percent change in the regional CPI, only when that change is above zero.
rules.penalty: Up to $500 for a first offense, up to $750 for a second, and up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense. The amount wrongfully charged is taken from the penalty and remitted to the applicant.
rules.status_basis: Takes effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment (approved January 20, 2026).

exempt_if.text: a dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent

exempt_if.name: real_estate_licensee_not_landlord
exempt_if.text: a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property

coverage.summary: Applies to application fees for residential rental property leased or subleased for dwelling purposes.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Does not apply to units in one- or two-family dwellings or to NJ Real Estate Commission licensees who are not the landlord.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
